# 18 More examples of Sturm-Liouville problems

Do problems 1-5 [here](./text/18ex-more-examples-of-sturm-liouville-problems.pdf){target="_blank"}. Note that this textbook uses different notation compared to our solutions in class. What we called $f(x)$ this textbook calls $X(x)$, what we called $\mu_n$ this textbook calls $\alpha_n$, and what we called $\ell$ this testbook calls $c$.
